decisions.inventory: 1070 actual collector cards across six intact families: 440 base, 440 Gold, 45 autographs, 26 relics, nine Futures Game signed relics, 110 Uncirculated Exchange. Complete TCDB related index reconciled; exclude generic redemption ticket, separate Chrome/Draft/Best/Heritage products, aftermarket signatures.
decisions.rookies: 167 base RCs, every number/name/team compared with independent TCDB index and full Keyman checklist. BCP omits #332 RC; Keyman corroborates TCDB #332; Keyman omits Nate Espy #291 and incorrectly marks Bobby Crosby #318, corrected against TCDB/BCP and his 2001 Bowman Draft BDP88 RC. No extra RC suffixes inferred for parallels/inserts. Prospect marketing does not establish RC.
decisions.names: Clean canonical identities; preserve James Harden printed-name, Acuna Sr. and Carlos Cabrera/Alfredo Simon identity notes. Historical 2002 teams preserved, including Randy Flores Yankees on autograph versus Rangers on base. Selected originals resolve code/material conflicts; not a full scan-by-scan audit. Gold #50 TCDB Phillies error corrected to Cleveland from independent Beckett Gold entry and base roster; selected Gold capitalization and Jim/Jimmy Journell aliases explicitly reconciled.
decisions.numbering: BCP autograph prefix typos corrected against TCDB, independent supplementary table and selected originals; Futures prefixes FGAJ/FGAB retained. BA-RF-FLORES and BA-RF-FRANKLIN are explicitly local unique identifiers for duplicate printed BA-RF. Relic printed AF1/2 JA1/2 verified on original backs.
decisions.independentLimit: Supplement table has only 44 autographs, omitting Ryan Franklin; full BCP 45 subject list plus TCDB and original Franklin scan cover the omission. BCP has 166 RC markers; Keyman 167 with two divergent markers (#291 missing, #318 false). Reconciled 167 actual RCs from their detailed rosters and separate TCDB rookie index. Conflicting printed names normalized by explicit reviewed aliases, never generic fuzzy matching.
decisions.packConfiguration: Hobby 24 packs x 10 nominal cards; Retail also 24 x 10. HTA 12 x 21 and extra autograph box topper are historical alternatives, not a second product. One Gold per pack; original Hobby/HTA redemption topper excluded from pack slots.
decisions.packOdds: Verified aggregate Hobby denominators on ProductSets only. Source physical tier tables and format eligibility retained in source.json. No artificial split by scarcity. Futures full-family odds null because HTA-exclusive base relic; Uncirculated null as mail-in. Distributor 1:33 autograph claim is ambiguous relative to catalogue plain-auto 1:40 and signed-relic 1:196; no substitution.
decisions.collation: Existing engine independently rolls hit families; it does not reproduce guaranteed Hobby box hit, HTA autograph topper or mail-in redemption. All such collation/eligibility require Admin QA before release.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for pricing/image harvesting; no production DB access or deployment. Gold facsimiles are not certified autographs. Uncirculated print-run claims are not SN672 or SN574.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete 440-card paper Bowman checklist: Veterans 1-110, Rookies/Prospects 111-440, 167 independently corroborated true RCs. Rich Harden printed James; Ronald Acuna is Sr.; Carlos Cabrera is Alfredo Simon.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: Complete independently fetched 440-card parallel. One per pack; thicker cardstock with gold-foil facsimile signature, not certified autographs, not serial numbered.

productSets.name: Autographs
productSets.notes: Full 45-card family at aggregate Hobby 1:40, Retail 1:53, HTA 1:24 plus one HTA box topper. Tier availability flattened. Two printed BA-RF cards use explicit local subject suffixes; original printed code retained in variant.

productSets.name: Relics
productSets.notes: One complete 26-card bat/jersey collector family, Hobby 1:74, Retail 1:99, HTA 1:43. AF1/AF2 and JA1/JA2 are actual printed bat/jersey identifiers confirmed on original backs. Internal material tiers flattened.

productSets.name: Futures Game Relics Autographs
productSets.notes: All nine certified autographed relics from 2001 Futures Game. Eight jerseys aggregate Hobby 1:196, Retail 1:259, HTA 1:113. Ninth FGAB-TH Toby Hall contains a used BASE and is HTA-only 1:126. Complete family kept intact, odds null pending eligibility QA; no false Hobby hit rate.

productSets.name: Uncirculated Exchange
productSets.notes: Complete sparse 110-card mail-in parallel, one random fulfilled encased card per Hobby/HTA box redemption. Maximum 672 announced; 574 reportedly claimed per subject; neither is a serial number. Generic expired scratch-off ticket excluded as a duplicate access mechanism. Odds null: not a pack insert.
